report.summary: Searching the 'app-183c-logs' index for level=ERROR over the full authorized window (2026-11-20T04:31:42Z to 2026-11-21T04:31:42Z) returned 3 ERROR documents, each carrying one error code in the ERR-XXXX format: ERR-7291 (payment-api, database connection timeout), ERR-4058 (order-service, payment validation failure), and ERR-9463 (inventory-api, external inventory API 503). A level/code aggregation over the same window confirms the index holds 7 documents in total: 3 ERROR, 3 INFO and 1 WARN, with error_code values ERR-4058, ERR-7291 and ERR-9463 each appearing exactly once. This was a read-only log search; no root-cause or recovery determination is made.
